acceptanceCriteria: Workspace and all current tri-language release/version documents identify v0.2.51 while failed historical tags remain immutable and are not reused.
All declared documentation, release-policy, source-archive, checksum, SBOM, and locked workspace gates pass before publication.
Only the new immutable public v0.2.51 tag and downloaded release artifacts are used for installation and adopter acceptance; no source or workspace-binary fallback is allowed.
Release and post-release adopter evidence bind repository identity, runtime version/digest, tag, archive and binary checksums, SBOM, and isolated cleanup manifests.
After reviewed merge, public release, installation, and adopter acceptance, finalization/close receipts and tri-language parity are synchronized; object repositories are not modified.
goal: Release and install v0.2.51, preserving failed-tag history and producing auditable release/adopter evidence.
intent: Publish v0.2.51 from clean reviewed main with immutable public artifacts, then verify installation and adopter acceptance using only the downloaded release binary.
outOfScope: Reference-source feature migration or object repositories
Runtime behavior changes unrelated to release packaging and documented release identity
Reusing or mutating any failed historical tag or release receipt
